head_commit.message:
Evolabs v0.7.0: reliable studio UI and selectable local models

Rebuild the product experience around a reliable script-to-screenwriter flow, selectable local Agent models, clearer Runtime diagnostics, a restrained monochrome interface, and a complete Windows release quality gate.

release.name: Evolabs Agent Studio v0.7.0
release.body:
Evolabs Agent Studio v0.7 introduces a reliable script-to-screenwriter flow,
a restrained professional interface, selectable local Agent models,
clearer Runtime/model diagnostics, and a rebuilt monochrome identity.

## What's Changed
* Evolabs v0.7.0 — reliable studio UI and selectable local models by @Michael173-lang in https://github.com/Michael173-lang/Evolabs-Agent-Studio/pull/1
